messages:
maria-recruiter: Heads up — during the nightly ATS bulk import a subset of candidate packet attachments are showing as 0 bytes after the job completed. Noticed it in the recruiter queue this morning :grimacing:

maria-recruiter: Rough numbers: job id 559, ~4.2k rows, ~40 attachments affected (~1% of candidates). Files were originally ~1.2–3MB.

maria-recruiter: Import log shows recurring warnings then a final success:```
2026-03-23T04:12:33Z INFO import: starting batch 34/42
2026-03-23T04:12:38Z WARN upload: attachment 0x7f9b truncated while streaming
2026-03-23T04:12:38Z WARN upload: retrying (1/3)
2026-03-23T04:12:40Z WARN upload: attachment 0x7f9b truncated while streaming
2026-03-23T04:12:40Z ERROR upload: max retries exceeded for attachment 0x7f9b
2026-03-23T04:12:42Z INFO import: batch 34 completed
```

maria-recruiter: @alex-ops can you check whether this is the S3 multipart proxy flaking again? We had a similar blip last quarter but it usually left failed rows flagged, not zero-byte files.

alex-ops: On it. Looking at the raw job output now. Quick question — are the zero-byte files present in the raw import staging bucket or only after the ATS service writes them?

maria-recruiter: I checked a sample — the staging bucket object sizes look correct. The zero-bytes appear in ATS after the post-import move.

sarah-peopleops: This is pretty urgent — the hiring team uses those packets for triage. If we need a manual rollback plan I'm happy to coordinate comms with affected recruiters.

jamie-atsbot: job 559 status: COMPLETED with warnings. Detected 38 attachments with E_UPLOAD_TRUNCATED returned from putAttachment(). See runbook: https://docs/internal/ats/runbooks#E_UPLOAD_TRUNCATED

leo-eng: Thanks @jamie-atsbot. I'm pulling the ATS service logs for the same window. Can someone paste the import manifest ID?

maria-recruiter: manifest-id: import-20260323-559.json. I uploaded a small sample payload to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/incoming/559-sample.zip

leo-eng: Scanning logs... I see repeated 499/timeout from the internal attachment-proxy during the post-processing move:```
[2026-03-23T04:12:38Z] proxy: upstream returned 499 while reading response header
[2026-03-23T04:12:38Z] proxy: wrote 0 of 327680 bytes
```

leo-eng: That matches zero-byte symptom — proxy closed connection mid-stream but our post-processing step marks the attachment as stored without verifying checksum in this codepath.

alex-ops: Noted. We should probably revert that optimistic flagging until we add a checksum validation. For immediate mitigation, do we have the originals in the staging bucket to rehydrate?

maria-recruiter: Originals are intact in staging for all affected samples I spot-checked.

anne-hiring-manager: If you need manual rehydration, we can deprioritize non-urgent roles, but we need those for next-day interviews in two teams. Please flag which candidate packets are impacted.

sarah-peopleops: Action items: 1) engineering to patch optimistic flagging + add checksum (leo), 2) ops to run rehydrate job for affected manifest (alex), 3) people-ops will notify recruiters for affected candidates (sarah). Agree? :+1:

leo-eng: Agree. I'll open a PR to add checksum verification and a fallback retry. ETA EOD for a small patch, can push a hotfix if needed.

alex-ops: I'll queue a rehydrate job now referencing import-20260323-559.json — running in dry-run first to list candidates, then actual rehydrate. Dry-run started:```
$ ./tools/ats_rehydrate --manifest import-20260323-559.json --dry-run
Found 38 attachments flagged as truncated. Candidates: 6, 12, 19, ...
```

alex-ops: Dry-run looks good. I'll run rehydrate in ~15m. Anyone want to review the list before I run it?

maria-recruiter: Please run — I can follow up with affected recruiters after.

anne-hiring-manager: Please cc me on the candidate list for the two interviews I mentioned.

jamie-atsbot: rehydrate job queued as job 560 by alex-ops. Notifying stakeholders.

alex-ops: Rehydrate completed. 38 attachments restored from staging, checksums verified post-restore. Job 560 exit=0.

leo-eng: Patch merged to main with checksum validation and an extra verification step in post-processing. Will roll out to canary ASAP.

sarah-peopleops: Thanks all. I'll send a short note to the recruiter channel summarizing impact + recovered list. If anything else shows up for other imports, please ping this thread. :handshake:

maria-recruiter: Huge thanks — saved the morning for our teams. :coffee:
